title: feat(console): the docs reader lists the candidate packages when a doc name two packages ship is refused
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9RpEW8k6PfkxHahidoPk4Au)_

Fixes #34070
Waits-on: #34036 — satisfied: merged to main as `5af956f3`; this branch merged `origin/main` at `37ea190a`.
Clause-②: yes (widening) — widened: where a doc read that names no package answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming its holders (`details.candidates`), the Console docs reader lists those packages, each linking to that package's address `/apps/PACKAGE/docs/NAME`, where it showed "Failed to load documentation"; a flat permalink under a package container of a name that package ships opens the doc in that package's own book; three `@object-ui/i18n` keys (`help.docConflictTitle`, `help.docConflictDescription`, `help.docConflictCandidates`) in all 11 shipped locales, none renamed or removed. A doc one package ships, and every other failure, render as before.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:两个启用的包发布同名文档时,Console 文档页不再显示笼统的「Failed to load documentation」,而是列出提供该文档的各个包(先显示包在文档门户里的名字,旁边是包 id),点哪个就在那个包的地址 `/apps/包id/docs/文档名` 下打开那一份,并且侧边栏是那个包自己的书。
- 为什么改:落实裁决 6893582352(#33264):服务端在 PR #34036 合并后,不指明包读取同名文档会回 409 并列出候选包,Console 要把候选包显示出来让用户选,而不是报错。
- 风险与回滚:只在读取返回 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` 且带候选包时生效;单持有者的文档、401/403、404 和其他错误都照旧。另含一处小修:在包容器下打开同名文档时,首页书按该包自己的那份来定(否则会落进另一个包的书)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/apps/console/src/pages/DocPage.tsx` 的 `conflictCandidates` 与 `state === 'conflict'` 分支;`ui/apps/console/src/pages/DocsSlug.tsx` 的 `ownCopy` 一行;`docs-portal.test.tsx` 末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/docs-portal.test.tsx -t objectstack#34070`,预期 4 个用例通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(#34036 已合并,本分支已并入 main)。

## What changes

PR #34036 (merged as `5af956f3`; read first at its head `e4b68eb2b`) makes a doc read that names no package, of a name two or more enabled packages ship, answer `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with every holder named. The envelope this PR reads, and where it was read:

- The thrown refusal: `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` (`code = 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT'`, `status = 409`, `refusal.candidates`) in `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`; #34036 throws it from `readMetaItem` through `refuseAmbiguousBareDocRead` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts` on its head; on main the judge call in `readMetaItem` is unchanged — the file differs from that head only by an unrelated action-artifact hunk).
- The wire: the `GET /meta/:type/:name` handler answers it with `handleRouteError(res, error, undefined, { packageScopedCandidates: true })` (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-routes.ts`), which puts the holders at `details.candidates` (`packageScopedCandidatesMember`, `packages/rest/src/error-response.ts`).
- The client: `unwrapResponse` in `packages/client/src/index.ts` sets `err.code`, `err.httpStatus` and `err.details = errorBody.details` on the rejection.
- The docs: `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`, the `/meta` 409 section ("The server picks no holder for you"): `err.httpStatus === 409 && err.code === 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT'`, then `err.details?.candidates` = `[{ kind: 'package', packageId }, …]`. The head and the docs agree.

Where the 409 lands in the Console: a flat `/docs/NAME` permalink of a name in the member's doc list redirects (DocsSlug) to `/docs/BOOK/NAME`, and DocPage's read there names no package, so the refusal reaches DocPage, which rendered "Failed to load documentation". The change sits there:

- `DocPage.tsx`: `conflictCandidates(err)` reads a `409` `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` rejection's `details.candidates` and keeps the `package` holders. Non-empty ⇒ a `conflict` state: a "Choose a package" list, each entry labelled as the portal names the package (its home book for this doc, `homeBook(name, books, docs, packageId)`), the package id beside it, linking to `/apps/PACKAGE/docs/NAME` (the package container's flat permalink, the address the app header's docs link already uses). Every other failure keeps today's branch.
- `DocsSlug.tsx` + `book-nav.ts`: `homeBook` takes an optional `packageId`. Under `/apps/PACKAGE/docs/NAME`, when that package ships `NAME`, its own copy decides the home book. Without this, the redirect took the first listed doc of the name, so a candidate link landed in the OTHER package's book (content right, since DocPage reads with `?package=`, sidebar wrong). No other URL changes its answer: the package is passed only when the container ships the name.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: `help.docConflictTitle`, `help.docConflictDescription` (`{{name}}`), `help.docConflictCandidates`, in all 11 locale packs; `zh-Hant.ts` regenerated with `gen-zh-hant.mjs` from `zh-Hans.ts`.

Candidates of another kind (`environment`, `platform`, `residual`) are not listed: for a `doc` the environment's own item answers first (#34036), so a doc refusal names packages only; a refusal naming no package keeps today's error state.

## Tests

New top-level describe in the shared harness `ui/apps/console/src/pages/docs-portal.test.tsx` (real DocsLayout / DocsSlug / DocPage under the real route table, `/docs` and `/apps/:appName/docs`), with a third adapter world: `shared_guide` shipped by `com.example.beta` (listed first) and `com.example.alpha`; a read of it with no package rejects the way `@objectstack/client` does on the 409 (`httpStatus`, `code`, `details.candidates`); with a package it answers that package's copy.

- a 409 with two candidates lists both, each linking to `/apps/PACKAGE/docs/shared_guide`, labelled `Alpha` / `Beta` with the id beside it; no doc body, no load error.
- each candidate opens that package's doc in that package's book: alpha lands on `/apps/com.example.alpha/docs/com.example.alpha/shared_guide` with alpha's body, beta likewise.
- CONTROL: a doc one package ships renders as today, no list.
- CONTROL: a non-409 failure (500) keeps today's "Failed to load documentation" with the server's message, no list.

No existing test was edited (the hoisted adapter gained the third world, switched on only inside the new describe).

<details><summary>Ablation (two legs, each red, each restored)</summary>

Both through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, pins run with `-t objectstack#34070` (ui vitest resolves `@object-ui/*` and the Console to `src/`, so no build sits between mutation and run):

- A, the conflict branch never taken (`if (holders) {` to `if (holders && (false as boolean)) {` in DocPage): anchor 1 to 0, blob `217c8533` to `19bdbb86`; 2 failed, 2 passed (both candidate pins: `Unable to find role="list"`). Restored: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- B, the container no longer decides the home book (`homeBook(slug, books, docs, ownCopy ? appName : undefined)` to `homeBook(slug, books, docs, undefined)` in DocsSlug): anchor 1 to 0, blob `6164bc8b` to `37d661e1`; 1 failed, 3 passed (`expected '/apps/com.example.alpha/docs/com.example.beta/shared_guide'` where alpha's book was pinned). Restored: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The card names `DocsSlug.tsx` / `DocShell.tsx` "as located"; the refusal lands in `DocPage.tsx` (the reader's read is the one that names no package), so the chooser is there. DocsSlug's single-name probe (`refusalFor`, run only for a name the member's lists do not carry) still reads only 401 / 403 as an answer; a 409 there keeps today's fallback. Not exercised: a name both holders ship is in the member's list, so that probe does not run for it.
- The candidate's label is the package's home book label for this doc (the implicit book's humanized id, or an authored book's label): the Console has no package-label source; the id is shown beside it.
- Candidate links depend on the exact `?package=` doc read answering that package's doc. #34040 tracks a composed artifact server answering the other holder's doc there; not in this PR.
- Sequencing: built against #34036's head while it was open; #34036 has since merged (`5af956f3`), `origin/main` was merged into this branch at `37ea190a` and the pins re-run there (Verification, round 2).

## Verification

**Round 2, after #34036 merged — head `37ea190a`** (merge of `origin/main` `385ea1cc` into `be6b38f6`, no conflict): the envelope files are byte-identical to the #34036 head read in round 1 (`git diff --quiet` exit 0 for `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`, `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-routes.ts`, `packages/rest/src/error-response.ts`, `packages/client/src/index.ts`, `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`); `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts` and `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` equal the merge commit `5af956f3`'s, with `refuseAmbiguousBareDocRead` called at the same spot. The branch delta against `origin/main` is still these 16 files (+264 / -14). After `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and rebuilding `@objectstack/client...`, `@objectstack/formula...`, `@objectstack/sdui-parser...` (`VERDICT command-exit 0`): pins `-t objectstack#34070` 4 passed; `apps/console/src/pages/` 159 files, 1333 tests passed; `packages/i18n/` 102 files, 1894 passed, 13 skipped.

**Round 1:** All readings at head `be6b38f6` (this branch), objectstack-ai/objectstack, base `63db7240`. The ablation legs ran at `9854afce`, whose `ui/apps/console` tree is byte-identical at this head (`git diff --quiet` exit 0; the later commits add the changeset and regenerate `zh-Hant.ts`); the pins were re-run at this head.
